mitigation_incremental_cost_index.unit: synthetic index points per mitigation decision
mitigation_incremental_cost_index.rationale: Spans low-friction capacity substitution through materially expensive rerouting without claiming observed market cost.

avoided_dwell_fraction.unit: fraction of modeled disruption delay eligible for avoidance
avoided_dwell_fraction.rationale: Represents partial through substantial avoidable dwell while keeping unavoidable disruption time explicit.

reroute_success_probability.rationale: Covers unreliable, credible, and highly reliable mitigation execution without treating the range as empirically calibrated.

stockout_penalty_per_exposed_day_index.unit: synthetic index points per uncovered inventory day
stockout_penalty_per_exposed_day_index.rationale: Represents low through high inventory exposure while preserving scenario-specific inventory cover as a fixed replay input.

service_impact_cost_per_delay_day_index.unit: synthetic index points per delay day at HIGH criticality
service_impact_cost_per_delay_day_index.rationale: Represents bounded service impact across delay-sensitive cohorts; replay SLA criticality supplies the fixed cohort multiplier.
